title: HVE: hide() kills Slint event loop on Wayland

architecture.gui: Slint 1.x with winit backend on Wayland
architecture.event_loop: slint::run() blocks on the winit event loop
architecture.tray: ksni crate runs a system tray icon in a separate thread
architecture.ipc: Unix socket server in a separate thread, dispatches commands to Slint event loop via slint::invoke_from_event_loop
startup_modes: --tray: window hidden via hide() BEFORE run()

bug.summary: Calling window.hide() during run() exits the winit event loop on Wayland, killing the process even when running in --tray mode.

steps_to_reproduce.2: Window starts hidden (hide() called before run()) — event loop stays alive
steps_to_reproduce.3: IPC command 'toggle-tray' calls window.show() — window appears
steps_to_reproduce.4: IPC command 'toggle-tray' again calls window.hide() — HVE process dies immediately
steps_to_reproduce.5: hve-ipc status returns 'HVE is not running' — socket file cleaned up

bug.expected_behavior: window.hide() should only hide the window, not exit the event loop. The tray (ksni thread) should keep the process alive.
bug.actual_behavior: window.hide() causes window.run() to return immediately, executing ipc::cleanup() and exiting the process.

what_works.hide_before_run: window.window().hide() BEFORE window.run() works fine — event loop stays alive with the tray
what_works.on_close_requested: window.window().on_close_requested(|| CloseRequestResponse::HideWindow) works for WM close events (SUPER+C), but does NOT affect programmatic hide()
what_works.set_minimized: window.window().set_minimized(true) is ignored by Hyprland (Wayland protocol: minimize is advisory)

what_doesnt_work.hide_during_run: window.window().hide() during run() kills the event loop on Wayland

key_files.src/main.rs: main entry, window setup, hide() before run(), on_close_requested

tried_fixes.on_close_requested_hide: CloseRequestResponse::HideWindow — only works for WM close, not programmatic hide()
tried_fixes.hide_before_run_only: Hiding before run() is safe, but we need to hide/show during run() for toggle-tray

bug.question: How can we programmatically hide/show a Slint window during the event loop on Wayland without exiting the event loop?
